title: "Academic Writing"

```{r}
#| include: false
# The list comes from Zotero through data/publications.json (R/publications.R).
source("R/publications.R")
site <- yaml::read_yaml("data/site.yml")
scholar <- Filter(function(p) p$name == "Google Scholar", site$profiles)[[1]]$url
n_journal <- pub_count(c("articles", "commentaries"))
n_phrase <- if (n_journal %% 10 == 0) n_journal else paste("over", n_journal %/% 10 * 10)
```

I have authored `r n_phrase` journal articles, as well as a range of other output. My policy reports are listed on the [Policy & Advisory](../policy/index.qmd) page.

The most up-to-date list of publications is available on my [Google Scholar profile](`r scholar`).

```{r}
#| output: asis
pub_list(c("articles", "commentaries", "chapters", "working-papers"))
```
